text:
Jacob Quillan was called back up by Vancouver on Nov 21, after a short stint in the AHL, and played 10:54 in a 4-3 win over Minnesota. He's a 24-year-old undrafted center who was the Most Outstanding Player of the 2023 NCAA tournament when Quinnipiac won the national title.

The NHL sample is tiny: four games with the Canucks this season, one assist, after 23 games with Toronto last season. Our numbers can't say much yet. Vancouver has been about even in shot attempts with him on at five on five, a little behind in chance quality.

The Canucks have been shuttling players between Vancouver and Abbotsford as injuries come and go, and Quillan has been part of that churn. Evolving-Hockey noted he faced tough competition in his limited minutes in Toronto.

What to watch: whether he sticks this time. He's here because the Canucks needed bodies, and the job is to make that harder to undo.
